events.name: Energy Music Tour
events.when: annually in late August; 2025 edition held 30 August at Strandbad Wannsee
events.blurb: Large free open-air pop/dance festival held directly on the beach at Strandbad Wannsee, with a food court, beach chill-out and swimming area. It returns to the lido where it began in 2003 and typically features major chart acts.

events.name: Wannsee in Flammen (Saisonende / season finale)
events.when: annually in late September; traditional season-end fireworks over the Wannsee, visible from the Strandbad shore
events.blurb: Traditional Berlin fireworks event marking the end of the bathing and passenger-ship season, with illuminated boat parades by Stern und Kreisschiffahrt and fireworks over Lake Wannsee. The display can be watched from the shore of Strandbad Wannsee.

events.name: Start of the Bathing Season at Strandbad Wannsee
events.when: annually in spring (around Easter / May), opening the summer lido season
events.blurb: Seasonal opening of Berlin's historic 1920s lido, one of Europe's largest inland beaches, marking the start of the summer swimming season on Lake Wannsee.

events.name: Malle Open Air at Loretta am Wannsee
events.when: annually in late spring; 2026 edition on 23 May at Loretta am Wannsee
events.blurb: Mallorca-style open-air party by the water at the Loretta am Wannsee beer garden near the Wannsee waterfront, with German pop/Schlager acts such as Julian Sommer and Lorenz Buffel.

events.name: Oktoberfest at Loretta am Wannsee
events.when: annually in September/October; 2026 dates include 18 September at Loretta am Wannsee
events.blurb: Bavarian-style Oktoberfest celebration at the Loretta am Wannsee beer garden with live music, beer and traditional food near the Wannsee waterfront.

events.name: Jazzfest Ahrenshoop
events.blurb: Annual jazz festival staged across roughly 17 venues throughout the artists' village of Ahrenshoop, presenting swing, Latin jazz, funk, brass, blues, boogie woogie and more. The 2026 edition (June 18-21) marks 25 years of the festival.

events.name: Kunstnacht Ahrenshoop (Art Night)
events.when: annually on the third Saturday in August (2026: August 15)
events.blurb: On the third Saturday in August, galleries, ceramic workshops and cultural venues across the artists' village open their doors for a night of exhibitions, concerts, readings and performances, with special light installations guiding visitors from house to house.

events.name: Ahrenshooper Filmnächte (Film Nights)
events.blurb: Annual German film festival hosted in Ahrenshoop, with a competition program of German feature films (some screened before their official cinema release) and jury and audience prizes. The 2026 edition runs November 11-14.

events.name: Strand- und Hafenfest Mönkebude
events.blurb: Traditional beach and harbour festival held on Mönkebude's beach at the Stettiner Haff since 1978, featuring the ceremonial arrival of the festival ship 'Greif von Ueckermünde', a family programme, food and drink stalls, and a fireworks display over the beach. It is a three-day event for the whole family.

events.name: Mönkebuder Deichlauf
events.when: annually on the Saturday of the Strand- und Hafenfest (early July)
events.blurb: Annual running event held during the Strand- und Hafenfest along the dike at the Stettiner Haff in Mönkebude, with routes of 2, 6 and 12 kilometres. The race typically starts on Saturday morning.
